g.text: Correct the file before changing the request.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #54635e

g.text: FICTIONAL TRAINING FILE: application, supporting worksheets and prices are constructed examples; no genuine borrower evidence.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #54635e

g.text: *The submitted screen deliberately uses the contract rate and unreconciled inputs. Seven discrepancies change recurring income to CAD 135,000, usable

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #54635e

g.text: cash to CAD 85,000, debt to CAD 750/month and the qualifying rate to 6.15%. The revised request changes only the hypothetical price to CAD 600,000,

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #54635e

g.text: with tax recalculated using the historical proxy. Both financial checks then fit, while six actual-evidence controls remain open. All stages remain on

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #54635e

g.text: hold. The worksheet packet supplies no real credit decision, signature or approval.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #54635e

g.text: Kevin Yamada | Canadian Household Finance | Official Canadian public sources
